# Alternator Diode Ripple and Voltage Regulation Check

**Make**: Honda
**Model**: Accord
**Year**: 2015
**Diagnostic Code**: P0622

## Description and Procedure
Battery warning light glowing dimly indicates alternator open diode. Check AC ripple voltage at B+ terminal under load.
Vehicle system troubleshooting guidance for P0622 on 2015 Honda Accord.
Always adhere to shop safety practices when servicing engine systems.
